body: Ruling step 1 done: S3 (#4362 5a4a2dc, plus the post-merge test fix 5b9312d) reverted out of integration at 74644c2 (pushed, check-ci-fast exit 0); the tree equals main at 719aa49 (the only newer main commit is #4365, TASK-3133). #4384 closed with the ruling cited. Reason: the signed S1b Q1 rule (a red Build is info only when an open red-main episode covers those checks) reads the watch episode state, which only S3a provides; S1b first would have to stub it. S3a reuses S3 at f037b9d minus every store effect (no fix spec, human item, completion, store spool; smoke evidence reported only) plus the in-scope p24 finding list. Starting S3a now on an integration branch.
